sys_script.description: Before-insert and before-update on x_casemgmt_case: refuses any write that would store an empty or whitespace-only subject, description or requester_name, naming the offending field via gs.addErrorMessage() and cancelling the write via current.setAbortAction(true). Closes QA finding F15 for the parent table: dictionary mandatory flags are form-time only, so POST /api/now/table/x_casemgmt_case {} previously returned HTTP 201 and stored a blank-shell case. Enforces AAP Section 0.5.7 (subject/description/requester_name Mandatory) and Section 0.7.3 Gate 1 (Zero missing mandatory fields) on every server-side write path - Table API, background script, Import Set, scoped Script Include. Order=50 is the lowest in the chain so a structurally invalid row is refused before the state-machine rules at 100-500 evaluate; orders 70 and 80 are reserved. Returns early on current.isActionAborted() so it never stacks a message onto an already-rejected save, and reproduces none of the four verbatim messages Section 0.7.4 fixes. Contains zero gs.eventQueue() calls per the email-disabled constraint.
sys_script.name: x_casemgmt_validate_case_mandatory_fields
